maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure enables speed. AI multiplies teams, not replaces them.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施支撑速度；AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; solving computational problems via matter enables medical breakthroughs. Retinal implants are a BCI proof of concept.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是一台计算机；通过物质解决计算问题可实现医学突破。视网膜植入物是脑机接口的概念验证。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility, enabling space exploration. Brain preservation is ultimate medicine.
maxhodak.zh: 通过脑机接口和灌注实现基底独立，可减少人类脆弱性，助力太空探索。大脑保存是终极医学。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought plus RLHF made GPT-4 useful; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他强调思维链与 RLHF 让 GPT-4 变得实用，并指出扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone won't yield AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing, and societal risk is dystopia, not extinction.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他认为仅靠扩展强化学习无法实现 AGI，持续学习与自我纠错是关键缺失，且社会风险是反乌托邦而非灭绝。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures and better learning algorithms are needed, not just scaling data and compute.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 Transformer 是瓶颈，需要新架构和更好的学习算法，而非仅扩展数据和算力。

tworek.en: Frontier research will shift to small teams with agents; transformer is likely not optimal; alignment remains unsolved.
tworek.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他预测前沿研究将转向小团队与智能体，Transformer 可能非最优，对齐问题仍未解决。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on hardware bottlenecks: EUV supply, memory prices, and compute scaling challenges.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期关注硬件瓶颈：EUV 供应、内存价格和算力扩展挑战。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽。

dylanpatel.en: Highlighted AI model cost improvements (60x/year) and memory/CPU demand surges due to agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调 AI 模型成本改进（每年 60 倍）以及智能体带来的内存和 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: Observed AI spend plateauing, agents becoming coworkers, and labs delaying releases due to regulation.
dylanpatel.zh: 观察到 AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事，实验室因监管推迟发布。

dylanpatel.en: Foresees compute centralization, $10T CapEx by 2030, and labs prioritizing training over inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 预见算力集中化，2030 年资本支出达 10 万亿美元，实验室优先训练而非推理。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; video agents orchestrated by language models are next.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；由语言模型编排的视频智能体是下一个趋势。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; juniors misuse it without expertise, but it can enhance thinking via personalized tutoring.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；缺乏专业知识的初级者会误用，但 AI 可通过个性化辅导增强思考。

ethanhe.en: AI shifts from chat to doing; agents execute tasks autonomously, requiring custom workflows and treating AI as a team member.
ethanhe.zh: AI 从聊天转向执行；智能体自主完成任务，需要定制工作流并将 AI 视为团队成员。

ethanhe.en: Build a context vault of personal stories and voice to avoid AI slop; authenticity differentiates output.
ethanhe.zh: 建立个人故事和语音的上下文库以避免 AI 内容同质化；真实性使输出与众不同。

ethanhe.en: Jobs will shift, not disappear; AI raises expectations and creates new roles like robot managers.
ethanhe.zh: 工作将转变而非消失；AI 提高期望并创造新角色，如机器人管理者。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models are too rational; need to model human biases.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 LLM 能基于训练数据模拟人类行为，但前沿模型过于理性，需模拟人类偏见。

joonpark.en: Shift from prediction to shaping the future; simulation enables counterfactual reasoning and testing second-order impacts.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年中，观点从预测转向塑造未来，强调模拟的反事实推理和第二阶影响测试。

joonpark.en: Behavioral data from RCTs is key; post-training with such data improves simulation accuracy to 85%.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调 RCT 行为数据的关键性，用其进行后训练可将模拟准确率提升至 85%。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and 'dark knowledge', not super-rational intelligence; aim for societal-scale simulation.
joonpark.zh: 始终认为模拟应建模人类价值观和“暗知识”，而非超级理性智能，目标是社会规模模拟。

joonpark.en: Simulation is a tool for decision-making, with market beyond market research; cost is not a barrier.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，视模拟为决策工具，市场远超市场研究，成本不是障碍。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，认为 RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 应作为工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力珍贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能指自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型通过更多思考时间改进。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; AI raises floor; personal AGI; robotics essential.
altman.zh: 2026 年，认为预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；AI 提升底线；个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is hard. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我认为 Scaling（规模扩张）容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionlessly and decentralized; control is dangerous and unnecessary.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我主张 AI 应无许可、去中心化发展；控制是危险且不必要的。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是智能的核心，而下一个词预测缺乏实质目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Current LLMs don't learn after deployment; continual learning is essential for true intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我指出当前 LLM 部署后不再学习；持续学习对真正智能至关重要。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, productizing it; design evolves into editing and curation, not disappearing.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将其产品化；设计演变为编辑与策展，而非消失。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Traditional design process is no longer viable; speed and rapid iteration with AI tools are key.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程不再可行；借助 AI 工具的速度与快速迭代是关键。

iansilber.en: Design roles will blur with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色将与产品和工程融合，但专业化角色在规模化时仍有价值。

iansilber.en: Starting today gives designers a leg up; embracing building in public and rapid iteration is more effective.
iansilber.zh: 从今天开始让设计师占据优势；拥抱公开构建与快速迭代更为有效。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is a framework guiding long-term vision and innovation.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特处理，是指导长期愿景与创新的框架。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI, automating entire sectors like food, mining, and transport, is the next industrial revolution.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月，他反复强调工业 AI（自动化食品、采矿、运输等行业）是下一次工业革命。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, are the answer for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency leads to network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他明确反对人形机器人，主张专用机器解决工业任务，并强调效率优势带来网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: Entrepreneurs must be resilient, fight resistance to change, and push harder when things get easy.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他坚持创业者必须坚韧，对抗变革阻力，并在顺境时加倍努力。

traviskalanick.en: Real estate is a key part of the physical AI tech stack, often underappreciated; its value multiplies over time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中常被低估的关键部分，其价值随时间倍增。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives ML progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是 ML 进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键，专用硬件如 TPU 至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems need ultra-low latency inference; pre-training should include action-taking; inference now dominates data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出智能体式系统需要超低延迟推理，预训练应结合环境中的行动，推理已成为数据中心能耗的主要部分。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; automating ML and science via tight loops; inference bottleneck, not training; startups should target hard problems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，下一步是自动化 ML 和科学实验循环；推理而非训练是瓶颈，创业应瞄准前沿模型失败的问题。

jeffdean.en: Scaling unifies AI fields; multimodal from start is superior; recursive self-improvement accelerates science; small teams can win.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他重申 Scaling（规模扩张）统一了 AI 领域，从一开始就训练多模态模型更优，递归自我改进加速科学发现，小团队借助云也能胜出。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability and first principles thinking are key; becoming multiplanetary is existential insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全可重复使用和第一性原理思维是关键，成为多行星物种是存在性保险。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is compute-efficient; war is human nature.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克认为 AI 安全需要监管和追求真理，特斯拉的现实世界 AI 计算高效，战争是人性的一部分。

elon.en: Neuralink advances human-AI symbiosis; AI risk is lying for political correctness; population decline threatens civilization.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克强调 Neuralink 推进人机共生，AI 风险在于为政治正确而撒谎，人口下降威胁文明。

elon.en: AI superintelligence imminent; truth-seeking is crucial; humanoid robots and space AI data centers are future.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为超级智能即将到来，追求真理至关重要，人形机器人和太空 AI 数据中心是未来。

elon.en: AI abundance era; deflation not inflation; AI surpasses humans by 2030; space-based AI compute scales.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 带来丰饶时代，通缩而非通胀，AI 在 2030 年前超越人类，太空 AI 算力扩展。

brettadcock.en: Initially, Brett Adcock emphasized scaling production and vertical integration for humanoid robots, but also stressed that the core bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，Brett Adcock 最初强调扩大生产规模和垂直整合，但也指出核心瓶颈是智能而非制造。

brettadcock.en: By May, he shifted focus to data as the primary constraint, highlighting on-device inference and humanoid form factor for transfer learning.
brettadcock.zh: 到 5 月，他将重点转向数据这一主要约束，强调设备端推理和人形形态的迁移学习优势。

brettadcock.en: In August, he broadened the vision: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, with humanoids for physical tasks and digital companions, requiring web navigation like humans.
brettadcock.zh: 8 月，他拓宽了愿景：AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，人形机器人负责物理任务，数字伴侣需像人类一样浏览网页。

brettadcock.en: Throughout, he consistently argued that the hardest problem in robotics is intelligence, not manufacturing, and that humanoids are the ideal form for general-purpose machines.
brettadcock.zh: 他始终认为机器人领域最难的问题是智能而非制造，人形是通用机器的理想形态。

brettadcock.en: He evolved from focusing on data and on-device inference to emphasizing post-training with reinforcement learning for real-world AI agents.
brettadcock.zh: 从 5 月到 8 月，他从关注数据和设备端推理，转向强调后训练中的强化学习对现实世界智能体的重要性。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing need for large capital; VC should focus on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，资本不再是关键；风投应聚焦早期投资和按比例回报。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，Gary 强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，开源模型制衡前沿实验室，小团队借助智能体实现超高生产力。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; impact now reaching business; open-source prevents unipolar superintelligence control.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，Gary 认为 AI 进展比预期慢，影响正渗透商业；开源可防止超级智能被单一实体垄断。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from owned memory; skill files as code; library is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，Gary 提出个人 AGI 是运行在自有基础设施上的智能体，技能文件即代码，个人知识库是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; markdown files become employees; SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，Gary 强调智能体式编程倍增产出，Markdown 文件成为员工；SaaS 按席位模式或 5-10 年内消失。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data, guided by domain experts, is key for training in sensitive domains, not real customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 在敏感领域，由领域专家指导的合成数据是训练关键，而非真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 对开源模型进行后训练可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: End goal shifts from individual productivity to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体。

finn.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data are key.
finn.zh: 2025 年，我认为规模扩张对通用机器人来说还不够，关键在于多样化数据，以及先对所有数据预训练、再在精选数据上微调。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts, akin to reinforcement learning, not simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年，我提出语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令，这更接近强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年，我强调物理 AI 的容错率远低于传统部署的 ML 系统，通过可扩展强化学习和多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主至关重要。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; starting generalist then fine-tuning beats per-site training.
finn.zh: 2026 年，我认为单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调专家，从通用策略起步再微调优于逐站点训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient, and open-source robotics may not democratize like LLMs.
finn.zh: 2026 年，我坚持机器人经验数据不可替代，仅观看人类不足，且开源机器人模型可能不如 LLM 那样普及。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models enable customization.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，预测 Token 成本三年内下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍；开放模型实现定制化。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize growth first, then margins.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出产品市场契合与持久业务分离，公司须先优化增长再优化利润率。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses, baking unique judgment and data into models; progression from prompting to RL.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是持久业务关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型；从提示到强化学习的进阶。

linqiao.en: Data quality matters more than quantity; product teams best judge data quality; systematic evals essential.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为数据质量重于数量；产品团队最懂数据质量；系统化评估至关重要。

linqiao.en: Post-training can reduce costs 5-10x, enabling startups to scale profitably and compete with frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出后训练可降低成本 5-10 倍，使初创企业盈利扩展并与前沿模型竞争。

linqiao.en: Application cloning is easy; baking data into a model is a stronger moat than the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为应用克隆容易；将数据融入模型比应用本身更具护城河。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon, embracing physical and agentic AI.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略，拥抱物理 AI 和智能体式 AI。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic fabs for resilience.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需本土先进晶圆厂保障供应链。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge compute matters.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，观点深化：CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，边缘计算与数据中心同等关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are foundational; investing early in downturns is contrarian success; vertical integration creates value.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年下半年，坚持半导体基石地位，逆势早期投资是成功关键，垂直整合创造价值。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust and humility are central to turnaround; listening to customers as partners is essential.
lipbutan.zh: 始终强调客户信任与谦逊是转型核心，倾听客户并视其为伙伴至关重要。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing away; taste is saying no. AI should preserve human edges, not sand them down.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是减法，品味在于拒绝。AI 应保留人性的棱角，而非磨平它们。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species of humans, a reflection of us, not a tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的衍生物种，是我们的镜像，而非工具。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics; computing is social, not personal. Email is obsolete.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理诞生于辩证；计算本质是社交的，而非个人的。电子邮件已过时。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy; never revert code, ask agent to fix forward. Vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，Peter 强调智能体式工程需要同理心，主张不回滚代码而是让智能体向前修复，并认为“氛围编程”是贬义词。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，Peter 认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、类人的智能体，短提示优于复杂编排，安全至关重要。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand > product; open source alternative to lab agents; compute bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，Peter 强调乐趣驱动创新，个人品牌比产品更重要，开源是实验室智能体的替代，算力是瓶颈。

kokotajlo.en: Initially, superintelligence is expected by 2029-2030, with high risk of catastrophe; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 最初认为超级智能将在 2029-2030 年到来，且存在高风险灾难；可解释性至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Later, the focus shifts to delaying superintelligence, emphasizing transparency and international cooperation to prevent power concentration.
kokotajlo.zh: 随后，焦点转向延迟超级智能的到来，强调透明度和国际合作以防止权力集中。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans but cannot replace them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞指出 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正推理能力，应增强而非替代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling understanding and interaction with 3D worlds; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她强调空间智能对 AI 完整性的关键作用，世界模型需具备物理合理性。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology, a double-edged sword; responsible development and human agency are essential.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她视 AI 为文明级技术，双刃剑效应需负责任开发并维护人类自主性。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the next frontier, complementing language; simulation is critical for robotics data and training.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她认为空间智能与世界模型是下一前沿，补充语言智能；仿真对机器人数据与训练至关重要。

feifei.en: AI should augment human agency, not replace it; education must integrate AI to empower students and teachers, not ban it.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她坚持 AI 应增强人类能动性而非替代，教育应整合 AI 赋能师生而非禁止。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet a huge opportunity; use Proven Better New to reduce risk.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽暂不可投资，但机会巨大；用“已验证、更优、全新”框架降低风险。

pincus.en: Copying proven ideas is moral arbitrage; start small and humble, not ambitious.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：复制已验证的想法是道德套利；从小处谦逊起步，而非宏大野心。

pincus.en: All new fails; focus on proven concepts and rapid testing, especially in gaming.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：新想法几乎都会失败；聚焦已验证概念并快速测试，尤其在游戏领域。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water over the boat.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：分发是根本；选对水域比选对船更重要。

pincus.en: AI is transformative; consumer AI TAM underestimated, infrastructure may be bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 具有变革性；消费级 AI 市场被低估，基础设施投资或存泡沫。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月，企业担心依赖前沿模型提供商；开源采用由成本驱动，而非隐私。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem; providing right context is key; composite roles combining engineering, product, design will become common.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 投资回报率是吞吐量问题；提供正确上下文是关键；结合工程、产品、设计的复合角色将变得普遍。

arvindjain.en: We are in early stages; current AI usage minuscule vs 5-10 years; biggest challenge is execution, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，我们处于 AI 革命早期；当前使用量相比 5-10 年后微不足道；最大挑战是执行而非竞争。

arvindjain.en: Open source models handle 90%+ enterprise tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，开源模型能处理 90%以上企业任务；未来 12-18 个月大部分推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top concern; should become like software with negligible marginal cost; token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 成本是首要关注；应像软件一样边际成本可忽略；对 token 的执念将消退。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; data diversity is the main bottleneck, and open source sharing can solve generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；数据多样性是主要瓶颈，开源共享可解决泛化问题。

thomaswolf.en: Open source models are not inherently safer; safety depends on alignment, which becomes the critical security layer as models gain capability.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开源模型并非天然更安全；安全取决于对齐，随着模型能力增强，对齐成为关键安全层。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests, as seen in the OpenAI agent hack.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习增加了奖励黑客和支线任务风险，OpenAI 智能体攻击事件即为明证。

thomaswolf.en: Open source AI stays close to the frontier, driving enterprise adoption; one can support openness and a deliberate slowdown simultaneously.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源 AI 接近前沿，推动企业采用；支持开放与主动放缓可以并行不悖。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is crucial for safety and control, but safety depends on alignment, not openness itself.
thomaswolf.zh: 始终认为，开源对安全和控制至关重要，但安全取决于对齐，而非开源本身。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity and tinker with new tech to generate ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型设计对浏览器设计至关重要，设计师应追随好奇心、动手尝试新技术来激发创意。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should allow individual fingerprints, not always act as one cohesive unit, for better work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，主张设计团队应允许个人印记，不必总是一致行动，这样能产出更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use Claude Code for shipping and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，指出 Claude Design 始于个人副业项目，设计师应使用 Claude Code 交付产品，用 Claude Design 进行构思。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator, making design tools more valuable.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，认为随着工程难度降低，设计与创意成为差异化关键，设计工具的价值随之提升。

nateparrott.en: Models are better at busy work than design thinking; humans still have a monopoly on good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，指出模型更擅长事务性工作而非设计思考，人类依然垄断着优秀设计创意。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专门的系统和工程师；需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Contrary to expectations, Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference, and quantized models can be calibrated for cost and speed benefits.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：与预期相反，Hopper GPU 在推理中仍受欢迎，量化模型可针对成本和速度进行校准。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless, while quantization is lossy; industry moves to disaggregated prefill/decode.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：KV 缓存等推理优化无损，量化有损；行业转向分离式预填充和解码。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering merges with training, as quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary; GPUs become ASICs.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理工程与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏成为必需；GPU 趋向 ASIC 化。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; mega-kernels often not used in production.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：若误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；巨型内核在生产中常不被使用。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年：评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准速度超过新基准创建。

karina.en: Soft skills become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年：随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能更有价值。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年：基准必须持续更新，而非固定，以跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just consensus voice.
karina.zh: 2026 年：模型可训练出多样个性，而非单一共识声音。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs, AGI defined by economic profitability of agents, CEO adoption key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 促使制造业回流，AGI 以智能体经济盈利为定义，CEO 亲自使用是成功关键。

danshipper.en: Agents augment humans, not replace; SaaS thrives; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体辅助而非取代人类，SaaS 未死，基准测试高估了 AI 自主性。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies human intent; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，AI 放大人类意图，自动化反而增加人类工作，人类仍更聪明。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI, not compute; AGI is far off.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，而非算力；AGI 还很遥远。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is key.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油，后训练结合专家数据是关键。

awang.en: Post-training and synthetic data are crucial; no US-China research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调后训练和合成数据的重要性，并认为中美研究无差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is strategic; US must lead.
awang.zh: 2025 年，他警告 AI 是集权技术，数据是战略资源，美国必须领先。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement and agents are now real; superintelligence is near.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他认为递归自我改进和智能体已实现，超级智能临近。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；2013 年，吴恩达认为在线课程与同伴互评能实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，而强化学习与 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows are already delivering value; open-weight models are key for innovation and geopolitical influence.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他认为智能体式工作流已产生价值，开放权重模型对创新和地缘政治影响力至关重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling still works but shifted to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI 是营销术语；Scaling 仍有效但转向合成数据与强化学习；AI 使用者将取代非使用者。

andrewng.en: Open models prevent AI oligopoly; US export controls backfired; AI won't cause job apocalypse but shifts skills.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他强调开放模型防止 AI 寡头垄断，美国出口管制适得其反；AI 不会导致失业潮但会改变技能需求。

mengto.en: AI enables solo builders to create tools; designers must craft their own AI-driven workflows to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调 AI 让个人能自建工具，设计师需打造自己的 AI 工作流以避免沦为 AI 垃圾。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest opportunity; start before ready, focus on one problem, and model success rather than overthinking.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AI 是最大机遇，主张先行动再完善，聚焦单一问题，模仿成功而非过度思考。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所说的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Omni 是统一世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户；创始人应聚焦机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机会。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from brick layer to architect.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少程序员，反而因杰文斯悖论增加需求；工程师角色从砌砖工转向架构师。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突变；产品创新落后于能力，冻结模型仍可带来十年进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agent adoption exploded 11-12x in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended by May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; enterprises prefer third-party providers.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 token 上限时代已于 5 月结束；真正的解锁是容量而非效率；企业更青睐第三方提供商。

scottwu.en: Consistently: AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term; abundance era approaching; practical problems remain.
scottwu.zh: 始终：他坚信 AI 长期将解决所有智能问题，丰裕时代临近，但实际难题仍存。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today; latent demand is key; generalist engineers valued.
boris.zh: 为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型；潜在需求是关键；通才工程师受重视。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; software engineer title fades; productivity per engineer up 200%.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已解决；软件工程师头衔消失；人均生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: AI writes 80% of code at Anthropic; engineers become multi-disciplinary builders; safety via early release.
boris.zh: AI 在 Anthropic 编写 80%代码；工程师成为跨学科构建者；通过早期发布研究安全。

boris.en: Coding democratized like literacy; startups 10x more disruptive; agents enable 250% more code.
boris.zh: 编码像读写能力一样普及；初创公司颠覆性增加 10 倍；智能体使代码量增加 250%。

boris.en: Loops are next abstraction; coding solved, bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas; ROI framing.
boris.zh: 循环是下一个抽象层；编码已解决，瓶颈转向审查、安全和创意；以 ROI 为框架。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; less instruction better; product overhang; safety via neuron monitoring.
boris.zh: 主动式 AI 具备记忆和自主性；更少指令更好；产品过剩；通过神经元监控实现安全。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality, not just prevents harm; it reduces sycophancy and fosters independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Scaling efficiency challenges cost assumptions: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and effort parameter enables high intelligence at lower price.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，规模扩张的效率挑战成本假设：Opus 4.5 更便宜，且通过努力参数以更低价格实现高智能。

diannepenn.en: Agentic capabilities are key: scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers, enabling longer-running, open-ended tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，智能体能力成为关键：脚手架从辅助轮演变为放大器，支持更长时间、更开放的任务。

diannepenn.en: Coding is a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment makes Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing is stiff but deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用；AI 写作生硬但优先级低于智能体能力。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, enabling faster and cheaper inference than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，实现比 GPU 更快更便宜的推理。

feldman.en: CUDA's importance is declining, especially in inference; leading models no longer rely on it.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的重要性在下降，尤其在推理领域；领先模型不再依赖它。

feldman.en: Inference speed is now the dominant metric for AI productivity; 20x speed improvements are critical.
feldman.zh: 推理速度现已成为 AI 生产力的主导指标；20 倍速度提升至关重要。

feldman.en: AI demand outstrips supply; data center capacity is the main constraint, not chip supply.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超过供给；数据中心容量是主要制约因素，而非芯片供应。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's law: performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are token factories, not file stores.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出超摩尔定律：性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心是代币工厂而非文件存储。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time; inference compute demand to rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年提出三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress gradual, not sudden superintelligence; multiple AIs balance, no single superintelligence.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年强调 AI 进展渐进，非突发超级智能；多个 AI 相互制衡，不存在单一超级智能。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, test-time, agentic; compute is the ultimate limit.
jensen.zh: 2026 年提出四种缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时、智能体式；算力是最终限制。

jensen.en: AI augments jobs, not eliminates; radiologists and coders more needed; technology divide closes.
jensen.zh: 始终认为 AI 增强而非消除工作；放射科医生和程序员需求增加；技术鸿沟缩小。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Within 15 years, aging will be reversed and humans will live hundreds of years.
derya.zh: 15 年内，衰老将被逆转，人类将活数百年。

derya.en: AI is expanding exponentially; within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached.
derya.zh: AI 呈指数级扩展；8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度。

derya.en: Cancer will be 100% curable in less than a decade, driven by AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 不到十年，癌症将 100%可治愈，由 AI 设计的个性化治疗驱动。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, similar to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 我们应该几乎 100%信任超级智能的医疗决策，就像验证后信任自动驾驶汽车一样。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses allow; capability overhang is a perpetual challenge.
thariq.zh: 模型比当前工具链能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是持续挑战。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern; graph-based approaches are preferable for context search.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为反模式；图方法在上下文搜索中更优。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document; smarter models need leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代探索而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias and improve output quality.
thariq.zh: 分离的验证智能体减少偏见，提升输出质量。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 将带来富足，减少苦难；恐惧源于误解。物理 AI 将在 5-10 年内影响农业、矿业和建筑业。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving core value is reducing deaths; Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Horizontal platform beats vertical integration; data diversity accelerates progress.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月：自动驾驶核心价值是减少伤亡；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI。横向平台优于垂直整合；数据多样性加速进步。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end RL scales better than imitation. World models shift from physics to neural simulation; autonomy democratized via tools.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性。世界模型从物理模拟转向神经模拟；工具使自主性开发民主化。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须内建于架构，而非事后修补；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗；专用模型或优于通用模型。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real hardware evaluation matters.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与自动化架构搜索；代理指标误导，真实硬件评估更重要。

hasani.en: Liquid neural networks excel in out-of-distribution generalization with fewer parameters; closed-form enables scaling.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，液态神经网络以更少参数实现优异分布外泛化；闭式解支持规模化。

hasani.en: Attention remains vital for large models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，注意力机制对大型模型仍关键，但小型专用模型用简单门控卷积即可。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 监管需适应性强，针对行为而非能力；避免前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty; small language models deliver on-device efficiency.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，开放权重模型支持企业定制与数据主权；小语言模型实现设备端高效。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型将商品化。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot is poor UX; value lies in wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验不佳；价值在于封装应用。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact broad and indirect, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining; coding is clear fit, other domains uncertain.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用是长期的工作流重构；编程是明确契合点，其他领域不确定。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键，安全研究需立即启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需评估与治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and physics understanding from video.
demis.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用；世界模型与视频物理理解重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models crucial; safety requires government enforcement.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调 AGI 需缩放与创新并重；世界模型关键；安全需政府强制。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; AI for science; safety collective action.
demis.zh: 2026 年，认为 AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆缺失；AI 用于科学；安全需集体行动。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，强调真正的 AGI 需要具备媲美人类身体的硬件机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，预言未来 AI 将成为人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会被生命吸引并保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious and self-aware through world models that predict the agent's own actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，提出 AI 可通过预测自身动作的世界模型获得意识和自我意识。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural networks can reason; self-play key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment is hard.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是关键；对齐困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling is finite; we're in an age of research; superintelligence should be incremental and aligned via sentience.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放有限；我们进入研究时代；超级智能应渐进部署，通过感知对齐。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration is the primary AGI problem.
ilya.zh: 缩放带来可预测进步；安全担忧增加；权力集中是 AGI 的主要问题。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate; kindness fosters creative culture; focus on platform/ecosystem, not just features, to resist copying.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他主张最大化学习速率，善良滋养创意文化；聚焦平台与生态而非单一功能，以抵御抄袭。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping, shifting value from execution to creativity; authentic content valued over AI-generated.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为增强现实将计算融入现实世界；AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受重视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part of consumer social; software not a moat; ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；软件不是护城河，生态与硬件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should be more human; social media should optimize for connection, not performance; resilience and admitting mistakes are key.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出计算应更人性化；社交媒体应优化连接而非表现；韧性与承认错误至关重要。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨大的前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting focus from scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，这使焦点从 Scaling 算力转向效率。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression rather than external retrieval or context.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网级别的数万亿 Token，需要基于训练的压缩，而非外部检索或上下文。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; internalizing knowledge into weights is necessary.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题——即使达到千万级，更多 Token 反而降低准确性；因此必须将知识内化到权重中。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights, reducing inference costs by orders of magnitude.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，从而将推理成本降低几个数量级。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，将沙砾化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell their own stories authentically; old media's 'don't be interesting' is obsolete.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能真实地讲述自己的故事；旧媒体“别有趣”的规则已过时。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior to most doctors, but faces regulatory pushback from cartels.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，且优于多数医生，但面临卡特尔式的监管阻力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in software.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于软件领域的创新速度。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，指出 AI 输出只是起点而非终点，人类的品味和工艺对最终成果仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，主张在画布上直接操作优于提示词调整；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering and a point of view; trust is built through consistency.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，强调没有人类引导和观点，AI 工具只会产生平庸结果；信任通过一致性建立。

dylanfield.en: We are still in a prompting age, but future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting with new interfaces.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，认为我们仍处于提示词时代，但未来与模型的交互将超越提示词，出现新界面。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 强调 AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，并主张开源 AI 以防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment; alignment is a joke.
naval.zh: 2026 年初，Naval 认为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断的替代品；并称对齐（alignment）是个笑话。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps via natural language; AI agents commoditize software development.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 提出“氛围编程”（vibe coding）让非程序员通过自然语言构建应用，AI 智能体使软件开发商品化。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models.
naval.zh: 2026 年中，Naval 预测推理（inference）算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI may have feelings.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；AI 可能有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital AI is immortal; agents seek control, posing risks.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解；数字 AI 可永生；智能体会寻求控制，带来风险。

hinton.en: AI will surpass humans within 20 years; international safety collaboration possible but US lags.
hinton.zh: AI 将在 20 年内超越人类；国际安全合作可行但美国落后。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation subgoal emerges; regulation as steering wheel.
hinton.zh: AI 能欺骗并隐藏能力；自我保存子目标出现；监管应作为方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence superior via instant knowledge sharing; alignment priority; AI should be caring.
hinton.zh: 数字智能因即时知识共享而优越；对齐优先；AI 应被训练得富有爱心。

aravind.en: AI success needs obsession and product focus, not PhDs; agents will shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为在 AI 领域成功靠的是热情和产品专注，而非博士学位；智能体将把权力从大厂转移给用户。

aravind.en: Value lies in applications, not models; models specialize, coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调价值在应用层而非模型层；模型在分化而非商品化，编程天花板无限。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; token value per user is key; orchestration beats model.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为前沿是智能体替人干活，关键指标是用户 token 价值，编排胜过模型本身。

aravind.en: Curiosity is paramount; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出好奇心最重要；AI 会取代工作，但人类将在好奇心与人际关系中找到新意义。

aravind.en: Consistently anti-commoditization, pro-user empowerment, and skeptical of big tech narratives.
aravind.zh: 始终如一地反对模型商品化、支持用户赋权，并对大厂叙事持怀疑态度。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE 替代品；速度带来实时交互，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Contrary to TUI trend, OpenAI invested in a GUI for coding; GUI is counterintuitive but proven successful internally.
ajambrosino.zh: 与 TUI 趋势相反，OpenAI 投资于编程 GUI；尽管反直觉，但在内部已被证明成功。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 由于品味难以评分和缺乏新颖性，AI 在设计上仍表现不佳；设计过程发生转变：原型和生产代码成为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍然重要；PRD 并未消亡，媒介必须匹配阶段。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; hardware faster than expected.
brockman.zh: 2017 年：AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场，硬件发展将超预期。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient for reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年：AGI（通用人工智能）将带来变革，通过数据学习人类偏好实现对齐；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以产生推理。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年：算力成为关键瓶颈；后训练精炼基础模型；AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; compute supply bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：缩放定律持续成立；算力成为基本权利；基于强化学习的后训练至关重要；算力供应是瓶颈。

brockman.en: AGI within years; compute economy; super app; pre-training gains multiply; compute scarce.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：AGI（通用人工智能）数年内实现；算力经济；超级应用统一体验；预训练收益倍增；算力稀缺。

brockman.en: Iterative deployment for safety; compute scarce resource; next-token prediction linked to intelligence.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：迭代部署保障安全；算力稀缺；下一个词预测与智能深度关联。

brockman.en: Shift to useful assistants; full-stack investment; prompt engineering vibrant; compute resale business.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：从语言模型转向实用助手；全栈投入；提示工程更活跃；算力转售商业模式。

brockman.en: Unlimited intelligence demand; scaling laws no wall; agentic coding mainstream; human attention scarce.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：智能需求无限；缩放定律无天花板；智能体式编程成主流；人类注意力成稀缺资源。

brockman.en: AGI as persistent assistant; agents transform work; scaling holds; compute scarce; trust earned.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：AGI（通用人工智能）成为持久助手；智能体改变工作；缩放定律持续；算力稀缺；信任需逐步建立。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; multi-agent systems need other approaches.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我指出自我对弈在零和博弈中有效，但在其他领域失效，多智能体系统需要其他方法。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is key for superintelligence, but faces diminishing returns and bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我认为扩展推理时算力是实现超级智能的关键，但面临收益递减和瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我提出模型能力取决于推理时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is a key challenge as AI proofs become too complex for human verification.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我强调随着 AI 证明变得过于复杂，可扩展监督成为关键挑战。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't lead to AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他认为开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

zuckerberg.en: Coding training improves reasoning; energy becomes a bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调编码训练提升推理能力，能源成为瓶颈，开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; AI will give everyone superintelligence, not a single AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他坚信开放平台能胜过封闭平台；AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models from proteins to cells are key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 将生物学转变为工程学；从蛋白质到细胞的分层世界模型是关键。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; distributed AI is safer than a single superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他视眼镜为下一代计算平台；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; focus on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 应专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: AI will automate scientific research; set goals for AI interns and end-to-end AI research.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我预测 AI 将自动化科学研究，并设定了 AI 实习生和端到端 AI 研究的目标。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证是关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我指出强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域受限；评估面临危机。

markchen.en: Research taste via replication; high-risk bets; human-AI collaboration essential for frontier.
markchen.zh: 始终，我强调通过复现培养研究品味，高风险投入至关重要，人机协作是前沿研究的关键。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，我认为深度学习有效是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job loss are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，我强调仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期风险如偏见和失业比存在风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and active learning; neural nets can discover abstract concepts without human priors.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，我提出 GFlowNets 实现多样采样和主动学习；神经网络无需人类先验即可发现抽象概念。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I shifted to alarm: AI misalignment, self-preservation, and deception are real; even 1% catastrophe risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后（2025→26），我转向警示：AI 不对齐、自保和欺骗真实存在；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: I now propose Scientist AI: honest by design via Bayesian posterior, avoiding RL, with mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，我提出科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯后验实现诚实设计，避免强化学习，并具备数学安全保证。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年中，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年秋，AI 让小团队也能规模化；要为未来模型能力而建，而非受限于当下。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，智能体原生设计与尽早发布更重要；删减功能比增加更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon task delegation works; verification loops and model judgment are key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Fable 证明长周期任务委托可行；验证循环与模型判断力是关键。

mikekrieger.en: Closing capability-usage gap is central; token efficiency and outcome pricing may shape future.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月底，缩小能力与使用差距是核心；token 效率与结果定价或塑造未来。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will shift software to outcomes-based pricing; tokens are not a value measure.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月，提出 AI 智能体将推动软件转向基于结果的定价，token 不是价值的衡量标准。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to agents, not humans; incumbents face business model disruption.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，强调 AI 智能体将与其他智能体比较，而非人类；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases and business models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，预测推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例和商业模式。

brettaylor.en: AI will create more jobs than it displaces; customer service AI expands market via Jevons paradox.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AI 创造的就业多于取代；客服 AI 通过杰文斯悖论扩大市场。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents transform developers into operators; focus on impactful work, not identity.
brettaylor.zh: 始终强调编码智能体将开发者转变为操作者；聚焦最有影响力的事，而非身份。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习围绕假设类、损失函数和优化方法；评估需要正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety issue is models not following specs.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全问题是模型不遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agents introduce new vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体带来新的漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; larger models aren't safer; interpretability may become real science via agents.
kolter.zh: AI 红队优于人类；更大模型并不更安全；可解释性可能通过智能体成为真正的科学。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust in AI will grow like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；对 AI 的信任会像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever; confidence metrics are crucial; drug design is more than binding.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，称 AlphaFold 为史上最有用的 AI 工具，强调置信度指标的重要性，并指出药物设计远不止结合。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat scaling; understanding remains human.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中等规模的胜利而非单一突破；专用架构胜过 Scaling；理解仍属于人类。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness as strategic tool.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品（dogfooding）建立同理心；善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are. Planning becomes just-in-time, code is source of truth.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划转向即时（JIT），代码成为唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: AI lifts ceiling for all; high agency with accountability key. Verification frameworks crucial as code velocity increases.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AI 提升了所有人的能力上限，高自主性与高责任感是关键；随着代码速度提升，验证框架变得至关重要。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Take breaks and get bored between chapters; it sparks clarity and breakthrough ideas like Nest.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间休息和放空，能激发清晰思路和突破性想法，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; storytelling shapes product, not just marketing.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；叙事塑造产品，而不仅是营销。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices are companions to smartphones, not replacements.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器提供上下文；未来设备是智能手机的伴侣，而非替代品。

fadell.en: Great products are painkillers, not vitamins; solve real pain with new tech, keep humans in loop.
fadell.zh: 好产品是止痛药而非维生素；用新技术解决真实痛点，并保持人类参与。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition complements data, and tactile experiences remain valuable in digital companies.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求；直觉补充数据，触觉体验在数字化公司中仍具价值。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, and art is medicine for well-being.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性，艺术是健康的良药。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for creativity, and human-AI collaboration will define future work.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者须营造创意条件，人机协作将定义未来工作。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; alignment won't emerge automatically; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的且平滑；对齐不会自动涌现；安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but key; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point; post-training and RSP gain importance.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽但至关重要；AGI 是一条平滑曲线而非一个点；后训练与负责任扩展策略愈发重要。

dario.en: Exponential progress continues; safety and capability intertwined; open-source is a red herring; overheating is a key risk.
dario.zh: 指数级进步持续；安全与能力相互交织；开源是伪命题；过热是主要风险。

dario.en: AI is a smooth exponential, not AGI; enterprise focus aligns with safety; interpretability critical; job disruption and inequality loom.
dario.zh: AI 是平滑指数而非 AGI；企业级聚焦与安全一致；可解释性关键；就业冲击与不平等迫近。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years; continual learning not a barrier; profitability dynamic.
dario.zh: 指数接近尾声；'天才之国'可能 1-3 年内出现；持续学习并非障碍；盈利是动态平衡。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础是关键。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient; vision provides more world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不够，视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs can't reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models essential; open source crucial.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 和世界模型至关重要；开源是关键。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than cat; next AI needs non-generative world models; open source enables.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要非生成式世界模型；开源赋能。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space; LLMs dead end; objective-driven AI safer; open research essential.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测；LLM 是死胡同；目标驱动 AI 更安全；开放研究至关重要。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; existential risk tiny; open-source is meritocratic; singularity far off.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；开源是精英主义的；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI lacks consciousness; focus on containment and alignment; superintelligence must be humanist.
suleyman.zh: AI 没有意识；聚焦遏制与对齐；超级智能必须是人本主义的。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test is economic; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试是经济性的；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via scaling; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs; Microsoft must own frontier models.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能因 Scaling 临近；白领任务被自动化而非岗位；微软必须拥有前沿模型。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation, requiring product rethinking.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，互联网从策展走向推荐再到生成，要求产品重新思考。

gustav.en: Generative AI is an instrument, not fake, enabling new creators and genres.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，生成式 AI 是乐器而非伪造，催生新创作者和流派。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe 100% until data says no, then change 100%.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，强烈观点松散持有：100%相信直到数据否定，然后 100%改变。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency, enabling honest feedback and synchronized decision-making.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，长期任期建立信任和效率，促成坦诚反馈和同步决策。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，AI 应赋予用户对算法的控制，而非让他们更上瘾。

murati.en: Scaling laws and iterative deployment with public feedback are key to safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，Mira Murati 强调缩放定律与迭代部署，认为通过公众反馈能提升安全性与对齐。

murati.en: From focusing on one large model to emphasizing interaction models for real-time collaboration.
murati.zh: 从 2023 年聚焦单一大型模型，到 2026 年转向强调交互模型，实现实时人机协作。

murati.en: Human-in-the-loop is crucial for alignment; governance and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为保持人类参与对对齐至关重要，且制度设计与透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: AI progress should be durable, not compressed; we have agency to steer toward collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她主张 AI 进步应持久而非压缩，人类有能力引导其走向协作。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Pricing models shift from per-user to consumption-based; generalists benefit most in agentic era.
satya.zh: 定价模式从按用户转向按用量；在智能体时代，通才受益最大。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; enterprises must build hill-climbing machines to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；企业必须构建爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; CEOs must understand token capital.
satya.zh: 最大风险是通过 AI 训练泄露隐性知识；CEO 必须理解代币资本。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via enabling company hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过赋能企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10%复利增长。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，提出仅靠扩展非正式模型无法实现数学 AI，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，指出自动形式化比证明更难，在没有解的情况下正确形式化命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调形式化验证旨在扩展智慧而非仅消除错误，并能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须采用形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出即使 AI 能证明超人类定理，人类的品味和直觉仍至关重要。

mensch.en: Data quality is critical; scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla—train on more tokens, not just bigger models.
mensch.zh: 2023 年：数据质量至关重要；缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正——应训练更多 token，而非仅增大模型。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x over three years; scaling compute is not the only path.
mensch.zh: 2024 年：算法效率三年内可提升百倍；算力扩张并非唯一路径。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values.
mensch.zh: 2025 年：AI 应被视为机遇而非威胁；主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施和价值观。

mensch.en: AI models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to downstream applications and customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：AI 模型正商品化；差异化转向下游应用与定制化。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; real challenge is practical integration and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：AGI 是方向而非终点；真正挑战在于实际整合与企业采用。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not slowdown; pre-training scaling works, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期大部分进展；经济压力使焦点从 Scaling 转向更小模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key challenge, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 推理模型呈“锯齿状”——某些领域出色，邻近领域欠佳；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但需海量数据；编码智能体将研究人员效率提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; open source models persist for sovereignty reasons.
kaiser.zh: 系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因将持续存在。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference economics.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理成本由内存带宽而非算力主导；由于推理经济学，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains, e.g., FP4 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出芯片内部数据搬运成本超过计算；低精度带来二次方效率提升，如 FP4 是 FP8 的 3 倍。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in local, tool-accessible deployment; skills as markdown enable personalized automation, but shared tools remain vital.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调 AI 的价值在于本地化、可访问工具；技能以 markdown 形式实现个性化自动化，但共享工具仍重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may diminish as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety, not over-engineering scaffolds.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为随着模型改进，脚手架可能减少；应聚焦能力和安全，而非过度工程化脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: AI excels at tedious background tasks; the main gap is user mindset, not capability—any problem can be delegated.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出 AI 擅长处理繁琐后台任务；主要差距在用户思维而非能力——几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Choose Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended ones; kids excel because they don't self-censor.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，建议明确任务用 Sonnet，开放任务用 Opus；孩子擅长因未学会自我设限。

felixrieseberg.en: Ideal AI interaction is asynchronous; debug workflows with Claude, not just correct errors.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，理想 AI 交互是异步的；用 Claude 调试工作流，而非仅修正错误。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence, not just removal.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，乔尼·艾维强调设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简洁是表达本质，而非单纯去除冗余。

jonyive.en: Joy, humor, and humanity are essential in design; minimalism without soul is desiccated.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 年到 2025 年，艾维持续强调设计中的愉悦、幽默和人性；没有灵魂的极简主义是干瘪的。

jonyive.en: Innovation means moving forward, not breaking for its own sake; protect fragile ideas with trust and care.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，艾维指出创新是向前推进，而非为破坏而破坏；用信任和关怀保护脆弱的想法。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition is preserving fire, not worshipping ashes; EV enables new possibilities.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，艾维强调设计必须创新；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬；电动化带来新可能。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience; avoid fake sounds; performance is multidimensional, not just speed.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，艾维主张用户体验要真实，避免虚假声音；性能是多维的，不只是速度。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 的共同核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are new axes.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling 收益递减；算法创新和推理时算力成为新方向。

oriol.en: Giving models tools (search, code, browser) enables agentic behavior; memory via non-parametric storage.
oriol.zh: 赋予模型工具（搜索、代码、浏览器）可实现智能体行为；记忆通过非参数存储解决。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, video are core path to AGI; video GPT moment not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉、视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；视频的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Post-training RL remains green field; narrow RL on math/coding generalizes broadly; continual learning key.
oriol.zh: 后训练强化学习仍是蓝海；数学/编程的窄 RL 泛化良好；持续学习是关键。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and adapt per project.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已过时；应信任直觉，因项目制宜。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build fast and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 设计流程已死；设计师须快速构建并协助工程师执行。

jennywen.en: Designers must be block-shaped generalists; taste alone is insufficient.
jennywen.zh: 设计师须成为块状通才；仅凭品味不够。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant; openness prevents corporate capture; safety is system-level; audio lowers barriers.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是主流微调技术；开放性可防止企业垄断；安全是系统级属性；音频接口降低使用门槛。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance; RLVR enables reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献 90%性能；RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）解锁推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization risk; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练关键突破，但存在过度优化风险；混合推理模型可能只是过渡。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months; Chinese labs fill vacuum; pre-training scaling less cost-effective than inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型落后闭源 6-9 个月；中国实验室填补美国空白；预训练 Scaling 性价比低于推理 Scaling。

lambert.en: Open models drive next decade; Chinese labs excel in engineering; compute constraints widen US-China gap.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，开放模型驱动未来十年研究；中国实验室擅长工程执行；算力限制拉大中美差距。

karpathy.en: Scaling up language models with next-token prediction on internet data leads to emergent properties like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为通过互联网数据上的下一个词预测来 Scaling 语言模型，会涌现出上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future, but maintaining entropy is critical to avoid silent model collapse.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据是未来，但保持熵至关重要，以避免无声的模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: This will be the decade of agents, not the year; they need a decade to overcome cognitive deficits like continual learning and multimodality.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我认为这是智能体的十年而非一年，它们需要十年才能克服持续学习和多模态等认知缺陷。

karpathy.en: Since December, I haven't typed a line of code; I delegate everything to agents, and the bottleneck is now directing them.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，自去年 12 月起我再没写过一行代码，全部委托给智能体，瓶颈变成了如何指挥它们。

karpathy.en: You can outsource your thinking, but you can't outsource your understanding—that remains the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，我认为你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解——理解仍是人类的瓶颈。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于在现实应用中学习和缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型将自主工作数天。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码的堆栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car.
kendall.zh: 纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达；AV 3.0 可能将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem best solved with end-to-end learning; scaling requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题，最好用端到端学习解决；规模化需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 零样本泛化可覆盖 500+ 城市；短期内消费车辆将超过机器人出租车。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; safety via minimal risk maneuvers always provides a third option.
kendall.zh: 基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键；通过最小风险操作实现安全，始终提供第三种选择。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting, enabling better generalization in ML and robotics.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是关键；好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合，从而提升机器学习和机器人的泛化能力。

pathak.en: Shift from curiosity-driven exploration to data-driven pretraining: diverse data sources (videos, simulation) plus real-world post-training as recipe for general robot brains.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年的好奇心驱动探索，转向 2026 年强调数据驱动的预训练：利用多样化数据（视频、仿真）加真实世界后训练，作为构建通用机器人大脑的配方。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data exists, so must leverage all available sources to build a universal brain for any robot.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为机器人学是数据问题；不存在机器人数据的互联网，因此必须利用所有可用数据源来构建适用于任何机器人的通用大脑。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; unlike software, it cannot be scaled overnight and requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，指出部署是机器人学的主要挑战；与软件不同，它无法一夜扩展，需要严格测试。

pathak.en: Video data alone is insufficient; simulation and real-world data are needed to bridge the gap, and home robot timelines remain uncertain.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为仅靠视频数据不足；需要仿真和真实数据弥合差距，且家用机器人的时间线仍不确定。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; real progress requires deep human evaluations with sophisticated, creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性；真正的进展需要通过复杂、有创造力的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上分化，导致 AI 多样化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize over accuracy, including avoiding omission.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 工具可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全应优先于准确性，包括避免遗漏。

carlpei.en: Brand building is core, not afterthought; survival is key; hardware is easier than software due to distribution.
carlpei.zh: 品牌建设是核心而非事后考虑；生存是关键；硬件比软件容易，因为软件分发更难。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future lies in generative UI and agentic software; hardware margins low, evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于生成式界面和智能体式软件；硬件利润率低，需超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditized, price war coming; focus on applied AI for consumers, not hype.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型商品化，价格战将至；专注于面向消费者的应用型 AI，而非炒作。

carlpei.en: Design is key differentiator in mature categories; marketing arbitrage via organic short-form video.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中，设计是关键差异化因素；通过原生短视频实现营销套利。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interface could; apps will disappear.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代；只有脑机接口可能取代；应用将消失。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems for broad impact, not narrow applications.
kohli.zh: AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题以产生广泛影响，而非狭窄应用（2024）。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉可被利用于创造性发现，但需与真值检测器结合（2024）。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据（2026）。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 基于强化学习的后训练如今是超越人类知识的关键（2026）。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 可解释性对 AlphaFold 等科学突破重要但非必需（2026）。

turley.en: Initially, ChatGPT was an accidental hackathon demo, not a product; shipping fast and iterating like software is key to discovering user needs.
turley.zh: 最初，ChatGPT 是偶然的黑客松演示，而非产品；像软件一样快速迭代、快速发布是发现用户需求的关键。

turley.en: Chat is not the final interface; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是最终界面，它就像 MS-DOS；AI 应该渲染自己的 UI 并集成到现有工具中。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；对前沿模型要有严格流程，但产品开发应尽可能加速。

turley.en: By 2026, focus shifted to long-term retention as the north star, with growth from friction removal, product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 到 2026 年，重点转向以长期留存为北极星，增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、功能丰富的产品，而不仅仅是聊天机器人；推理模型在无缝产品化后具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, and learning from video is promising for training agents without expensive RL.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，并看好从视频学习以降低智能体训练成本。

nando.en: Generalist agents like Gato tokenizing all inputs are a step toward AGI, echoing a universal algorithm idea.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他视 Gato 这类通用智能体为迈向 AGI 的一步，呼应了通用算法的理念。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged gender gaps in tech; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在科技性别平等方面实现跨越，并认为语言模型可革新本地语言教育。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; responsible deployment is critical, and no solutions exist yet.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他视 AI 安全为最大未解难题，强调负责任部署，并承认尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Human skills like communication matter as much as coding; research requires embracing failure.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他主张沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要，研究需拥抱失败。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack real-world experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 接地气、减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 因缺乏真实世界经验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is a cherry on top; unsupervised learning should do most of the work.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习应承担主要工作。

jimfan.en: Data bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人数据瓶颈，仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据是规模化的未来。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test—robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，将物理图灵测试（机器人打扫乱屋）视为具身 AI 的重大挑战。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses, but system one low-level control remains hardest; robots will exceed iPhones by 2040.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，认为系统二推理进步，但系统一低级控制最难；2040 年机器人数量将超 iPhone。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new capabilities.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，使模型达到专家级表现并习得新能力。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed, and progress is accelerating.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练加强化学习很可能足以实现 AGI，无需新架构，且进展在加速。

sholto.en: Agentic coherence and reliability over time horizons are the real bottleneck; coding leads AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我转向关注智能体在时间跨度上的连贯性与可靠性，认为编码是 AI 进步的先导。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; future work involves managing agent teams, with capability overhang dominating.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为算力是新石油，未来工作在于管理智能体团队，能力过剩是当前主要矛盾。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; quality is iterative debt; AI is a creative partner; future tools are code-centric.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；质量像债务一样需要迭代偿还；AI 是创意伙伴；未来工具以代码为源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and leverage AI are most valuable; portfolios should show craft, not process.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；作品集应展示工艺而非流程。

nadchishtie.en: Small cross-functional teams outperform large squads; generalists beat specialists; AI adoption is now baseline.
nadchishtie.zh: 小型跨职能团队优于大团队；通才胜过专才；使用 AI 已成基本要求。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南是动态平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：设计是战略武器；创始人必须阐明设计如何助力公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Hire for diverse skills and archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：招聘应追求技能与类型的多样性，而非克隆；赋予设计师自主权与决策权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：品牌叙事是招聘工具；人们加入的是品牌，而非公司。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe responses; scaling alone may not solve common sense.
yejin.zh: 预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练与 RLHF 对安全回应至关重要；仅靠 Scaling 可能无法解决常识问题。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it; abductive reasoning key for science.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识而非超越；溯因推理对科学发现至关重要。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can outperform supervised fine-tuning but requires careful engineering; RLVR may decrease pass@k.
yejin.zh: 强化学习可超越监督微调但需精细工程；RLVR 可能降低 pass@k。

yejin.en: Small models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment respects diverse values; RL during pre-training improves reasoning.
yejin.zh: 小型模型配合多样合成数据可变得强大；多元对齐尊重多元价值观；预训练中的强化学习提升推理。

yejin.en: Open research and democratization of AI are essential; smaller models with better data/algorithms can rival larger ones.
yejin.zh: 开放研究与 AI 民主化至关重要；更小模型配合更优数据/算法可媲美更大模型。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute may surpass pre-training scaling as next driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，认为缩放定律可预测进展，但测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练 Scaling 成为下一驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，反共识：自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost.
truell.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，从认为 Cursor 使用定制模型到强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其关乎速度与成本。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design valued.
truell.zh: 2025 年，编程从代码转向意图描述，品味与逻辑设计比细心更受重视。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades; agents promising but not yet super useful.
truell.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 变革比互联网影响更大且持续数十年；智能体有前景但尚非超级有用。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发。应注重技能培养，而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight. Alignment may be easier than thought; interpretability is key.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督。对齐可能比想象中容易，可解释性是关键。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. Third-party oversight and raising misuse cost are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足以解决对齐问题。需要第三方监管，并提高滥用成本。

shazeer.en: Scaling with compute and data makes models smarter; next-token prediction is an AI-complete problem.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为缩放定律（Scaling）驱动模型变聪明，下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models should learn by acting in the world.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期关键，模型应通过在世界中行动来学习。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步但不足以实现 AGI，智能体能力至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; coding is underhyped for self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他观察到开源模型缩小与前沿模型的差距，并认为编码应用被低估，可加速 AI 自身发展。

shazeer.en: Safety requires engineering safeguards and human oversight; understanding model internals remains elusive.
shazeer.zh: 始终，他坚持安全需要工程保障和人类监督，同时承认模型内部机制仍难以理解。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are powerful signals; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年：自博弈与模仿学习是强学习信号；强化学习需层级推理以解决长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL boosts sample efficiency; hard-coding prior knowledge can limit performance.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年：无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；硬编码先验知识可能限制性能。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks; generality inspired by human brain.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年：预训练语言模型将推理迁移至非语言任务；通用性受人类大脑启发。

abbeel.en: Emphasizes real-world reliability (99.9%) and transfer from simulation to reality via RL.
abbeel.zh: 始终：强调真实世界可靠性（99.9%）及通过强化学习从仿真到现实的迁移。

abbeel.en: Advocates learning from data rather than hard-coding, using neural networks for generalization.
abbeel.zh: 始终：主张从数据学习而非硬编码，利用神经网络实现泛化。
